title: Experiential Learning North Star and Future Student Entitlement
lead: TBC, Convener of the Experiential Learning Strategic Community of Practice

decisionLog.outcome: Confirmed the Year 1 delivery intent for 2.1.2: use the Strategic Community of Practice and existing institutional expertise to establish a clear King's experiential-learning North Star, define the future student-entitlement ambition and leave 2026/27 with a forward implementation plan. Delivery will overlap with 2.1.4 and 2.2.3 rather than waiting for a fully sequential hand-off.
